title: Every irreducible occurs in the staircase tensor square
exact_target: For every $m\geq 1$, put $N=m(m+1)/2$ and $\rho =(m,m-1,\dots ,1)$. Does the tensor square of the complex Specht representation $S^\rho $ contain every irreducible representation of $S_N$; equivalently, is $g(\rho ,\rho ,\lambda )>0$ for every partition $\lambda $ of N?
